source: hand-authored fixture for issue #560 — not shipped data
description: An operator dataset whose interaction note does not restate its Major rating but does contain the word 'moderate', beside a self-named allergy rule. The interaction finding carries a rating the record never states, so its findingSeverity is null; the allergy finding carries none. A Moderate the answer gives the allergy finding in a sentence citing both is not a rating the interaction carries, and unfoundedFindingSeverities must report it.

interactions.note: Even moderate doses may increase the risk of bleeding.
